fields.en: This paper reports on the Zr/Ce_TTp heterometallic MOF, which exhibits significant CO₂ reduction performance under simulated solar light. Its excellent photoelectric absorption capacity and charge separation efficiency make it a promising material for solar-driven CO₂ conversion. The material achieves efficient CO₂ reduction through the synergistic action of Ce III centers and stable Zr nodes, as well as the light absorption capability of the H2TTp linker. Both experimental and theoretical calculations support this conclusion, indicating that heterometallic MOFs have broad prospects in the application of π-conjugated heterocyclic linkers, and can serve as catalysts for the production of next-generation solar fuels.
fields.zh: 本文报道的Zr/Ce_TTp异金属MOF在模拟太阳光下表现出显著的CO₂还原性能，其优异的光电吸收能力和电荷分离效率使其成为太阳能驱动CO₂转化的有前景材料。该材料通过协同作用的Ce III中心和稳定的Zr节点，以及H2TTp链接器的光吸收能力，实现了高效的CO₂还原。实验与理论计算均支持这一结论，表明异金属MOF在π共轭杂环链接器的应用具有广阔前景，可作为下一代太阳能燃料生产催化剂。

fields.en: Future research can further explore the stability of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) under different lighting conditions and their performance changes over long-term use, while assessing their economic viability and scalability for practical industrial applications. Additionally, computational simulations can be used to further optimize the synergistic effects between heterometallic nodes and π-conjugated heterocyclic linkers, aiming to enhance the efficiency of photocatalytic CO₂ reduction.
fields.zh: 未来的研究可以进一步探索异金属MOFs在不同光照条件下的稳定性及长期使用中的性能变化，同时评估其在实际工业应用中的经济性和可扩展性。此外，可以通过计算模拟进一步优化异金属节点与π共轭异环链接构的协同作用，以提升光催化CO₂还原效率。

decisions.focus: Catalytic conversion of nitrogen to ammonia by a molecular Fe model complex

The study presents a significant advancement in the catalytic reduction of nitrogen to ammonia using a well-defined molecular Fe complex, offering insights into the mechanism of biological nitrogen fixation. The research demonstrates that a single Fe site can stabilize various NxHy intermediates and highlights the importance of geometric tunability at Fe for efficient catalysis. The work provides a detailed mechanistic understanding and validates the potential of a synthetic model system to mimic enzymatic processes.

classification_audit.abstract: The reduction of N 2 to NH 3 is a requisite transformation for life. 1 While it is widely appreciated that the iron-rich cofactors of nitrogenase enzymes facilitate this transformation, 2 - 5 how they do so remains poorly understood. A central element of debate has been the exact site(s) of nitrogen coordination and reduction. 6 , 7 The synthetic inorganic community placed an early emphasis on Mo 8 , because Mo was thought to be an essential element of nitrogenases 3 and because pioneering work by Chatt and coworkers established that well-defined Mo model complexes could mediate the stoichiometric conversion of N 2 to NH 3 . 9 This chemical transformation can be performed in a catalytic fashion by two well-defined molecular systems that feature Mo centres. 10 , 11 However, it is now thought that Fe is the only transition metal essential to all nitrogenases, 3 and recent biochemical and spectroscopic data has implicated Fe instead of Mo as the site of N 2 binding in the FeMo-cofactor. 12 In this work, we describe a tris(phosphine)borane-supported Fe complex that catalyzes the reduction of N 2 to NH 3 under mild conditions, wherein >40% of the H + /e - equivalents are delivered to N 2 . Our results indicate that a single Fe site may be capable of stabilizing the various N x H y intermediates generated en route to catalytic NH 3 formation. Geometric tunability at Fe imparted by a flexible Fe-B interaction in our model system appears to be important for efficient catalysis. 13 - 15 We propose that the interstitial light C-atom recently assigned in the nitrogenase cofactor may play a similar role, 16 , 17 perhaps by enabling a single Fe site to mediate the enzymatic catalysis via a flexible Fe-C interaction. 18

items.action: 氮气的固定是生命必需的过程，工业上通过固态铁催化剂在高温高压下实现，而自然界中则由氮酶酶在常温常压下完成。这些酶含有富含硫和铁的活性位点辅因子（FeFecofactor），可能还包含钼（FeMo-cofactor）或钒（FeV-cofactor）的位点。合成化学家长期以来致力于寻找能够催化N₂还原为NH₃的明确复合物，而Chatt早期关于低价态钼复合物的工作为这一问题提供了机制框架，即所谓的“Chatt”或“远端”机制，其中生成一个终端氮化物中间体（图1底部）。其他机制如“交替路径”也受到关注。尽管有显著进展，但使用明确的模型复合物直接催化N₂还原生成NH₃仍主要局限于Schrock和同事的三胺基胺钼系统以及Nishibayashi和同事最近发现的磷配位钼系统。然而，合成铁复合物中实现对N₂的质子和电子传递以催化生成NH₃仍然是一个未解难题。本文展示了一种新报道的单核铁复合物[(TPB)Fe(N₂)][Na(12-crown-4)₂]（TPB=三磷烷硼烷；见图2A），它可以在-78°C和一标准大气压下，在溶液中通过质子和电子还原N₂生成NH₃。此外，为了进一步探讨是否需要包含前体的(TPB)Fe复合物来促进整体催化，我们还考察了多种铁复合物在类似条件下的情况。其中最感兴趣的是[(SiP iPr₃)Fe(N₂)][Na(12-crown-4)₂]，它与[(TPB)Fe(N₂)][Na(12-crown-4)₂]结构相同但将硼原子替换为硅原子。两者的主要区别在于铁-硼键相对于顶位配体的位置远比铁-硅键更灵活。尽管在标准催化条件下观察到部分NH₃生成，但相对于铁的亚化学计量产率（0.7±0.5 equiv NH₃ per Fe equiv；entry 3）仍较低。此外，使用FeCl₂·1.5 THF、FeCl₃、Cp₂Fe和Fe(CO)₅等前体进行额外控制实验也仅产生极少量NH₃（<0.2 equiv在所有情况下平均；4次运行）。已知的磷支持的Fe(0)-N₂复合物Fe(depe)₂(N₂)也经过标准条件处理，但其每铁等价的亚化学计量产率仍较低。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即单个Fe位点可能能够稳定生成的N_xH_y中间体，并通过实验逐步验证该假说。首先，作者通过合成一个三(膦)硼烷支持的Fe复合物，证明其在温和条件下可催化N₂还原为NH₃，且>40%的H+/e⁻等价物被传递到N₂上。接着，作者通过多种实验手段（如EPR、NMR、UV-Vis、IR）分析该复合物的结构和反应中间体，发现其几何可调性可能对催化效率至关重要。此外，作者还比较了不同Fe位点的催化效果，排除了其他可能的替代解释，如Mo位点的作用，并提出C原子可能在Fe-C相互作用中起类似作用。综述分析通过组织和比较实验数据，确认了单个Fe位点的催化能力，并指出几何可调性的重要性。这些步骤对于理解氮固定机制至关重要。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过构建一个三磷ine硼烷支持的Fe复合物，揭示了单个Fe位点在催化N2还原为NH3过程中的关键作用。该模型系统中Fe-B相互作用的可调性对于高效催化至关重要，这一机制可能适用于其他过渡金属催化的类似反应。然而，这种灵活性主要依赖于Fe与B或C原子的相互作用，因此其适用范围受到特定配体结构的限制。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过设计一种三(膦)硼烷支持的铁复合物，成功实现了在温和条件下将氮气还原为氨。该体系中，超过40%的H+/e-等价物被传递到N2上，表明单个Fe位点可能能够稳定生成的各个NxHy中间体。几何可调性由灵活的Fe-B相互作用提供，对于高效催化至关重要。研究还提出，氮气酶辅因子中最近鉴定的C原子可能在类似角色中发挥作用，通过允许Fe-C相互作用的灵活性来实现酶促催化。该工作超越了常规流水线工作，基于具体设计、机制和发现，未虚构全球首次或依赖期刊判定优秀。
items.application_prospects: 本文报道了一种以Fe为中心的分子复合物，能够催化N₂还原为NH₃。该反应在-78°C下进行，且能高效地将H⁺/e⁻等价物传递至N₂。研究显示，单个Fe位点可能稳定生成的NₓHᵧ中间体，而Fe-B相互作用的可调性对催化效率至关重要。此外，文中提到的Fe-N₂复合物在不同条件下表现出良好的催化性能，表明其在氮固定领域的应用前景广阔。
items.future_directions: 本文提出未来可检验的问题：如何验证Fe-C相互作用在催化N2还原中的作用？是否可以通过合成包含C原子的模型系统来进一步探索这一机制？此外，如何优化Fe-B相互作用以提高催化效率？这些研究方向均基于本文中提到的Fe位点稳定性和几何可调性。

fields.en: The fixation of nitrogen is an essential process for life, achieved industrially through solid iron catalysts under high temperature and pressure, while in nature it is carried out by nitrogenases under ambient conditions. These enzymes contain active site cofactors rich in sulfur and iron (FeFeco-factor), which may also include sites with molybdenum (FeMo-cofactor) or vanadium (FeV-cofactor). Chemists have long sought to find specific complexes that can catalyze the reduction of N₂ to NH₃, and Chatt's early work on low-valent molybdenum complexes provided a mechanistic framework for this problem, known as the "Chatt" or "remote" mechanism, in which a terminal nitride intermediate is generated (Figure 1 bottom). Other mechanisms such as the "alternative pathway" have also been considered. Despite significant progress, the direct catalytic reduction of N₂ to NH₃ using well-defined model complexes remains mainly limited to the triamine molybdenum system of Schrock and colleagues, as well as the phosphorus-coordinated molybdenum system recently discovered by Nishibayashi and colleagues. However, achieving proton and electron transfer in iron complexes to catalyze the formation of NH₃ from N₂ remains an unsolved problem. This paper presents a newly reported mononuclear iron complex [(TPB)Fe(N₂)][Na(12-crown-4)₂] (TPB = triphosphane borane; see Figure 2A), which can reduce N₂ to NH₃ in solution at -78°C and one standard atmosphere by proton and electron reduction. Furthermore, to further explore whether the inclusion of a precursor in the (TPB)Fe complex is necessary for overall catalysis, we also examined various iron complexes under similar conditions. Of particular interest was [(SiP iPr₃)Fe(N₂)][Na(12-crown-4)₂], which has the same structure as [(TPB)Fe(N₂)][Na(12-crown-4)₂] but with the boron atom replaced by a silicon atom. The main difference lies in the flexibility of the iron-boron bond relative to the top ligand position, which is significantly greater than that of the iron-silicon bond. Although partial NH₃ generation was observed under standard catalytic conditions, the sub-stoichiometric yield per Fe equivalent (0.7±0.5 equiv NH₃ per Fe equiv; entry 3) remains low. Furthermore, additional control experiments using precursors such as FeCl₂·1.5 THF, FeCl₃, Cp₂Fe, and Fe(CO)₅ also resulted in only minimal amounts of NH₃ (<0.2 equiv on average in all cases; 4 runs). The known phosphorus-supported Fe(0)-N₂ complex Fe(depe)₂(N₂) was also treated under standard conditions, but its sub-stoichiometric yield per Fe equivalent remained low.

fields.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis that individual Fe sites may be capable of stabilizing the generated N_xH_y intermediates, and they gradually validated this hypothesis through experiments. First, the authors synthesized a Fe complex supported by a triphosphine borane and demonstrated that it could catalyze the reduction of N₂ to NH₃ under mild conditions, with more than 40% of H+/e⁻ equivalents transferred to N₂. Subsequently, the authors analyzed the structure and reaction intermediates of this complex using various experimental techniques (such as EPR, NMR, UV-Vis, IR), discovering that its geometric tunability may be crucial for catalytic efficiency. Additionally, the authors compared the catalytic effects of different Fe sites, excluding other possible alternative explanations, such as the role of Mo sites, and proposed that C atoms might play a similar role in Fe-C interactions. The review analysis confirmed the catalytic ability of individual Fe sites through organization and comparison of experimental data, and highlighted the importance of geometric tunability. These steps are crucial for understanding the mechanism of nitrogen fixation.

paragraphs.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis that individual Fe sites may be capable of stabilizing the generated N_xH_y intermediates, and they gradually validated this hypothesis through experiments. First, the authors synthesized a Fe complex supported by a triphosphine borane and demonstrated that it could catalyze the reduction of N₂ to NH₃ under mild conditions, with more than 40% of H+/e⁻ equivalents transferred to N₂. Subsequently, the authors analyzed the structure and reaction intermediates of this complex using various experimental techniques (such as EPR, NMR, UV-Vis, IR), discovering that its geometric tunability may be crucial for catalytic efficiency. Additionally, the authors compared the catalytic effects of different Fe sites, excluding other possible alternative explanations, such as the role of Mo sites, and proposed that C atoms might play a similar role in Fe-C interactions. The review analysis confirmed the catalytic ability of individual Fe sites through organization and comparison of experimental data, and highlighted the importance of geometric tunability. These steps are crucial for understanding the mechanism of nitrogen fixation.

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the critical role of individual Fe sites in the catalytic reduction of N2 to NH3 by constructing an Fe complex supported by a triphosphine borane. The tunability of Fe-B interactions in this model system is essential for efficient catalysis, and this mechanism may be applicable to similar reactions catalyzed by other transition metals. However, this flexibility primarily depends on the interaction between Fe and B or C atoms, thus its applicability is limited by the specific ligand structure.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过构建一个三磷ine硼烷支持的Fe复合物，揭示了单个Fe位点在催化N2还原为NH3过程中的关键作用。该模型系统中Fe-B相互作用的可调性对于高效催化至关重要，这一机制可能适用于其他过渡金属催化的类似反应。然而，这种灵活性主要依赖于Fe与B或C原子的相互作用，因此其适用范围受到特定配体结构的限制。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The study successfully achieved the reduction of nitrogen to ammonia under mild conditions by designing a iron complex supported by a triphosphineborane. In this system, more than 40% of the H+/e- equivalents are transferred to N2, indicating that individual Fe sites may be able to stabilize various NxHy intermediates generated. The geometric tunability is provided by flexible Fe-B interactions, which is crucial for efficient catalysis. The study also proposes that the recently identified C atom in nitrogenase cofactors may play a similar role, allowing flexibility in Fe-C interactions to achieve enzymatic catalysis. This work goes beyond conventional pipeline work, based on specific design, mechanism, and discoveries, without fabricating global first or relying on journal judgment of excellence.
fields.zh: 该研究通过设计一种三(膦)硼烷支持的铁复合物，成功实现了在温和条件下将氮气还原为氨。该体系中，超过40%的H+/e-等价物被传递到N2上，表明单个Fe位点可能能够稳定生成的各个NxHy中间体。几何可调性由灵活的Fe-B相互作用提供，对于高效催化至关重要。研究还提出，氮气酶辅因子中最近鉴定的C原子可能在类似角色中发挥作用，通过允许Fe-C相互作用的灵活性来实现酶促催化。该工作超越了常规流水线工作，基于具体设计、机制和发现，未虚构全球首次或依赖期刊判定优秀。

fields.en: This paper reports a molecular complex centered on Fe that can catalyze the reduction of N₂ to NH₃. The reaction proceeds at -78°C, and it efficiently transfers H⁺/e⁻ equivalents to N₂. The study shows that individual Fe sites may stabilize the generated NₓHᵧ intermediates, and the tunability of Fe-B interactions is crucial for catalytic efficiency. Additionally, the Fe-N₂ complex mentioned in the text exhibits good catalytic performance under different conditions, indicating a promising application prospect in nitrogen fixation.
fields.zh: 本文报道了一种以Fe为中心的分子复合物，能够催化N₂还原为NH₃。该反应在-78°C下进行，且能高效地将H⁺/e⁻等价物传递至N₂。研究显示，单个Fe位点可能稳定生成的NₓHᵧ中间体，而Fe-B相互作用的可调性对催化效率至关重要。此外，文中提到的Fe-N₂复合物在不同条件下表现出良好的催化性能，表明其在氮固定领域的应用前景广阔。

fields.en: This paper proposes testable future questions: How can the role of Fe-C interactions in catalytic N2 reduction be verified? Can this mechanism be further explored by synthesizing model systems containing C atoms? Additionally, how can Fe-B interactions be optimized to enhance catalytic efficiency? These research directions are based on the stability and geometric tunability of Fe sites mentioned in this paper.
fields.zh: 本文提出未来可检验的问题：如何验证Fe-C相互作用在催化N2还原中的作用？是否可以通过合成包含C原子的模型系统来进一步探索这一机制？此外，如何优化Fe-B相互作用以提高催化效率？这些研究方向均基于本文中提到的Fe位点稳定性和几何可调性。

decisions.focus: Band-bending engineering in Cu2ZnSnS4 photocathodes using a composite (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer for solar water splitting

This study presents a significant contribution to the field of photoelectrochemical (PEC) water splitting by demonstrating how precise engineering of a composite (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer (ETL) can enhance the performance of Cu2ZnSnS4 (CZTS) photocathodes. The research systematically investigates the impact of ETL thickness on band alignment, interfacial energetics, and charge-carrier transport, leading to a high photocurrent density and improved solar-to-hydrogen efficiency. The findings highlight the importance of controlled ETL engineering in optimizing the performance of earth-abundant materials for scalable solar fuel production.

classification_audit.abstract: The development of efficient and stable photocathodes from earth-abundant materials is a critical challenge for photoelectrochemical (PEC) hydrogen production. While Cu 2 ZnSnS 4 (CZTS) is a promising absorber due to its ideal bandgap and non-toxic constituents, its performance is plagued by severe interfacial recombination. This work addresses this limitation through the precise engineering of a zinc-titanium oxide (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer (ETL) in Mo/CZTS/CdS/(Zn,Ti)O/Pt photocathodes. We systematically investigate the influence of atomic-layer-deposited (Zn,Ti)O on the heterojunction's microstructure, band alignment, and charge transfer kinetics. A suite of characterization studies reveals that a suitable ETL thickness forms a dense, conformal coating and establishes an optimal spike-like conduction band offset at the CdS/(Zn,Ti)O interface, which minimizes bulk and interfacial charge-transfer resistance. Consequently, the optimized photocathode achieves a remarkable photocurrent density of 29.2 mA cm −2 at 0 V RHE and a high half-cell solar-to-hydrogen efficiency (HC-STH) of 7.02%. This study demonstrates that fine control of composite ETLs is a powerful strategy to unlock the potential of CZTS and related earth-abundant absorbers for scalable solar fuel production.

items.action:
本研究通过精确设计锌-钛氧化物（Zn,Ti）电子传输层（ETL），解决了Cu₂ZnSnS₄（CZTS）光阳极在太阳能水分解中的界面复合问题。该工作构建了Mo/CZTS/CdS/(Zn,Ti)O/Pt光电极结构，通过原子层沉积（ALD）精确控制(Zn,Ti)O层厚度为10、20和30 nm，并系统研究其对异质结微观结构、带对齐及电荷传输动力学的影响。结果表明，20 nm的(Zn,Ti)O层形成致密且无孔覆盖，优化了CZTS/CdS晶粒边界处的表面势分布，显著降低了体相和界面电荷转移电阻，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面形成了有利的尖峰状导带偏移（+0.10 eV）。这些协同效应使光电极在0 V RHE时实现了29.2 mA cm⁻²的高光电流密度，以及7.02%的半电池太阳能到氢气效率。KPFM分析进一步揭示了性能提升源于优化的界面带弯曲和均匀的表面势分布，这有助于高效的电荷分离与传输。研究还通过XRD和SEM验证了优化后的PC-2光电极在实际PEC操作条件下的结构稳定性，其CZTS吸收层及异质结界面保持完整无剥落或严重损伤，仅外层轻微降解。XRD图谱显示CZTS（112）峰强度降低而SnO₂（110）峰出现，表明表面含锡物种氧化为SnO₂，而非体相结构破坏。这些发现强调了对ETL厚度的精确控制对于优化带对齐和电荷管理在硫化物基薄膜光电极中的重要性，为基于丰富资源材料的高效太阳能燃料系统提供了通用策略。

本研究通过系统分析不同厚度的(Zn,Ti)O层对CZTS光电极性能的影响，揭示了精确控制ETL厚度对于提升光阳极性能的关键作用。20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层不仅实现了致密覆盖和优化的带弯曲，还显著降低了电荷转移电阻，从而提高了光电流密度和太阳能到氢气效率。KPFM分析进一步证实了界面带弯曲和表面势分布的优化对电荷分离与传输的促进作用。此外，XRD和SEM测试验证了优化后的PC-2光电极在实际PEC操作条件下的结构稳定性，其CZTS吸收层及异质结界面保持完整无损伤，仅外层轻微降解。这些结果表明，通过精确控制ETL厚度可以有效提升CZTS等丰富资源材料的光电性能，为规模化太阳能燃料生产提供了可行方案。

本研究的关键设计在于通过ALD技术精确调控(Zn,Ti)O层厚度，并系统分析其对异质结微观结构、带对齐及电荷传输动力学的影响。实验结果表明，20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层能够形成致密且无孔覆盖，优化了CZTS/CdS晶粒边界处的表面势分布，显著降低了体相和界面电荷转移电阻，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面形成了有利的尖峰状导带偏移。这些协同效应使光电极在0 V RHE时实现了29.2 mA cm⁻²的高光电流密度，以及7.02%的半电池太阳能到氢气效率。KPFM分析进一步揭示了性能提升源于优化的界面带弯曲和均匀的表面势分布，这有助于高效的电荷分离与传输。此外，XRD和SEM测试验证了优化后的PC-2光电极在实际PEC操作条件下的结构稳定性，其CZTS吸收层及异质结界面保持完整无损伤，仅外层轻微降解。这些结果表明，通过精确控制ETL厚度可以有效提升CZTS等丰富资源材料的光电性能，为规模化太阳能燃料生产提供了可行方案。
items.research_logic: 作者通过构建Mo/CZTS/CdS/(Zn,Ti)O/Pt结构，提出通过精确控制(Zn,Ti)O电子传输层（ETL）厚度来优化CZTS光电极性能的假说。通过系统研究不同厚度的ETL对异质结微观结构、带对齐和电荷转移动力学的影响，验证了20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层能形成致密覆盖并优化界面能级，从而降低电荷转移电阻，实现高光电流密度。综述分析通过对比不同厚度ETL的性能数据，指出20 nm层在带弯曲和表面势分布方面具有优势，进一步验证了该厚度的优化效果。这些步骤确保了实验结果的可靠性，并为后续应用提供了理论支持。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，通过精确控制电子传输层（ETL）的厚度，可以有效优化带隙对齐和电荷传输效率，从而提升光催化剂性能。该研究中，20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O ETL实现了密集、均匀的覆盖，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面形成有利的传导带偏移，显著降低了电荷转移电阻，最终获得高光电流密度和高效能。这一实验设计可迁移至其他宽禁带材料的光催化剂开发中，但需注意材料兼容性和界面缺陷控制。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过精确调控(Zn,Ti)O电子传输层（ETL）的厚度，优化了Cu₂ZnSnS₄（CZTS）光阳极的性能。20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层实现了致密、均匀的覆盖，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面形成有利的尖峰式导带偏移，有效抑制了缺陷介导的复合，从而显著提升了光电流密度至29.2 mA cm⁻²和半电池太阳能到氢效率7.02%。这种精确控制ETL厚度的方法展示了如何超越常规流水线工作，通过系统分析结构、能带对齐和电荷传输动力学，实现了CZTS等丰富资源材料在可扩展太阳能燃料生产中的潜力。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过精确调控(Zn,Ti)O电子传输层（ETL）厚度，优化了Cu₂ZnSnS₄（CZTS）光电极的性能，实现了高效的太阳能水分解。该研究展示了通过控制ETL厚度可有效改善带偏移和电荷传输，从而提升光催化效率。实验表明，20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层能形成致密均匀的覆盖层，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面产生有利的尖峰传导带偏移，显著降低电荷转移电阻，使光电流密度达到29.2 mA cm⁻²。该成果为利用地球丰富材料开发可扩展的太阳能燃料系统提供了策略。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探索不同厚度的(Zn,Ti)O电子传输层对CZTS光电极性能的影响，特别是在极端操作条件下的稳定性与长期循环性能。此外，可以利用第一性原理计算来预测不同掺杂浓度和厚度组合对带偏移和载流子迁移率的影响，以优化材料设计。这些研究将有助于深入理解界面工程在提高太阳能燃料生产效率中的作用。

fields.en:
This study addresses the interfacial recombination issues in Cu₂ZnSnS₄ (CZTS) photoanodes for solar water splitting by precisely designing a zinc-titanium oxide ((Zn,Ti)O) electron transport layer (ETL). The work constructs a Mo/CZTS/CdS/((Zn,Ti)O)/Pt photoelectrode structure, where the thickness of the ((Zn,Ti)O) layer is precisely controlled by atomic layer deposition (ALD) to be 10, 20, and 30 nm. The effects of these layers on the microstructure of the heterojunction, band alignment, and charge transport dynamics are systematically studied. Results show that a 20 nm ((Zn,Ti)O) layer forms a dense and pore-free coverage, optimizes the surface potential distribution at the CZTS/CdS grain boundaries, significantly reduces the bulk and interfacial charge transfer resistances, and creates favorable sharp band offset ( +0.10 eV) at the CdS/((Zn,Ti)O) interface. These synergistic effects enable the photoelectrode to achieve a high photocurrent density of 29.2 mA cm⁻² at 0 V RHE and a half-cell solar-to-hydrogen efficiency of 7.02%. KPFM analysis further reveals that the performance improvement is due to optimized interfacial band bending and uniform surface potential distribution, which are beneficial for efficient charge separation and transport. The study also verifies through XRD and SEM that the optimized PC-2 photoelectrode maintains structural stability under actual PEC operating conditions. The CZTS absorption layer and heterojunction interface remain intact without peeling or severe damage, with only minor degradation on the outer layer. XRD patterns show a reduction in the intensity of the CZTS (112) peak and the appearance of the SnO₂ (110) peak, indicating that surface tin species are oxidized to SnO₂, rather than destruction of the bulk structure. These findings emphasize the importance of precise control of ETL thickness for optimizing band alignment and charge management in sulfide-based thin-film photoelectrodes, providing a general strategy for efficient solar fuel systems based on abundant resource materials.

This study reveals the critical role of precise control of ETL thickness in enhancing the performance of photoanodes by systematically analyzing the effects of different thicknesses of (Zn,Ti)O layers on the photovoltaic properties of CZTS. A 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer not only achieves dense coverage and optimized band bending but also significantly reduces charge transfer resistance, thereby improving the photo-current density and solar-to-hydrogen efficiency. KPFM analysis further confirms the promoting effect of optimized interfacial band bending and surface potential distribution on charge separation and transport. Additionally, XRD and SEM tests verify the structural stability of the optimized PC-2 photoanode under actual PEC operating conditions, where the CZTS absorption layer and heterojunction interface remain intact without damage, with only minor degradation observed in the outer layer. These results indicate that precise control of ETL thickness can effectively enhance the photovoltaic properties of resource-rich materials such as CZTS, providing a feasible solution for large-scale solar fuel production.

The key design of this study lies in precisely controlling the thickness of the (Zn,Ti)O layer through ALD technology, and systematically analyzing its effects on the microstructure of the heterojunction, band alignment, and charge transport dynamics. Experimental results show that a 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer can form a dense and pore-free coverage, optimizing the surface potential distribution at the grain boundary of CZTS/CdS, significantly reducing the bulk and interfacial charge transfer resistances, and forming favorable peak-like conduction band offsets at the CdS/(Zn,Ti)O interface. These synergistic effects enable the photoelectrode to achieve a high photocurrent density of 29.2 mA cm⁻² at 0 V RHE, as well as a half-cell solar-to-hydrogen efficiency of 7.02%. KPFM analysis further reveals that the performance improvement is attributed to optimized interfacial band bending and uniform surface potential distribution, which are beneficial for efficient charge separation and transport. Additionally, XRD and SEM tests verify the structural stability of the optimized PC-2 photoelectrode under actual PEC operating conditions, with the CZTS absorption layer and heterojunction interface remaining intact and undamaged, while only the outer layer shows slight degradation. These results indicate that precise control of ETL thickness can effectively enhance the photovoltaic performance of rich resource materials such as CZTS, providing a feasible solution for large-scale solar fuel production.

本研究通过精确设计锌-钛氧化物（Zn,Ti）电子传输层（ETL），解决了Cu₂ZnSnS₄（CZTS）光阳极在太阳能水分解中的界面复合问题。该工作构建了Mo/CZTS/CdS/(Zn,Ti)O/Pt光电极结构，通过原子层沉积（ALD）精确控制(Zn,Ti)O层厚度为10、20和30 nm，并系统研究其对异质结微观结构、带对齐及电荷传输动力学的影响。结果表明，20 nm的(Zn,Ti)O层形成致密且无孔覆盖，优化了CZTS/CdS晶粒边界处的表面势分布，显著降低了体相和界面电荷转移电阻，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面形成了有利的尖峰状导带偏移（+0.10 eV）。这些协同效应使光电极在0 V RHE时实现了29.2 mA cm⁻²的高光电流密度，以及7.02%的半电池太阳能到氢气效率。KPFM分析进一步揭示了性能提升源于优化的界面带弯曲和均匀的表面势分布，这有助于高效的电荷分离与传输。研究还通过XRD和SEM验证了优化后的PC-2光电极在实际PEC操作条件下的结构稳定性，其CZTS吸收层及异质结界面保持完整无剥落或严重损伤，仅外层轻微降解。XRD图谱显示CZTS（112）峰强度降低而SnO₂（110）峰出现，表明表面含锡物种氧化为SnO₂，而非体相结构破坏。这些发现强调了对ETL厚度的精确控制对于优化带对齐和电荷管理在硫化物基薄膜光电极中的重要性，为基于丰富资源材料的高效太阳能燃料系统提供了通用策略。

本研究通过系统分析不同厚度的(Zn,Ti)O层对CZTS光电极性能的影响，揭示了精确控制ETL厚度对于提升光阳极性能的关键作用。20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层不仅实现了致密覆盖和优化的带弯曲，还显著降低了电荷转移电阻，从而提高了光电流密度和太阳能到氢气效率。KPFM分析进一步证实了界面带弯曲和表面势分布的优化对电荷分离与传输的促进作用。此外，XRD和SEM测试验证了优化后的PC-2光电极在实际PEC操作条件下的结构稳定性，其CZTS吸收层及异质结界面保持完整无损伤，仅外层轻微降解。这些结果表明，通过精确控制ETL厚度可以有效提升CZTS等丰富资源材料的光电性能，为规模化太阳能燃料生产提供了可行方案。

paragraphs.en: This study addresses the interfacial recombination issues in Cu₂ZnSnS₄ (CZTS) photoanodes for solar water splitting by precisely designing a zinc-titanium oxide ((Zn,Ti)O) electron transport layer (ETL). The work constructs a Mo/CZTS/CdS/((Zn,Ti)O)/Pt photoelectrode structure, where the thickness of the ((Zn,Ti)O) layer is precisely controlled by atomic layer deposition (ALD) to be 10, 20, and 30 nm. The effects of these layers on the microstructure of the heterojunction, band alignment, and charge transport dynamics are systematically studied. Results show that a 20 nm ((Zn,Ti)O) layer forms a dense and pore-free coverage, optimizes the surface potential distribution at the CZTS/CdS grain boundaries, significantly reduces the bulk and interfacial charge transfer resistances, and creates favorable sharp band offset ( +0.10 eV) at the CdS/((Zn,Ti)O) interface. These synergistic effects enable the photoelectrode to achieve a high photocurrent density of 29.2 mA cm⁻² at 0 V RHE and a half-cell solar-to-hydrogen efficiency of 7.02%. KPFM analysis further reveals that the performance improvement is due to optimized interfacial band bending and uniform surface potential distribution, which are beneficial for efficient charge separation and transport. The study also verifies through XRD and SEM that the optimized PC-2 photoelectrode maintains structural stability under actual PEC operating conditions. The CZTS absorption layer and heterojunction interface remain intact without peeling or severe damage, with only minor degradation on the outer layer. XRD patterns show a reduction in the intensity of the CZTS (112) peak and the appearance of the SnO₂ (110) peak, indicating that surface tin species are oxidized to SnO₂, rather than destruction of the bulk structure. These findings emphasize the importance of precise control of ETL thickness for optimizing band alignment and charge management in sulfide-based thin-film photoelectrodes, providing a general strategy for efficient solar fuel systems based on abundant resource materials.

paragraphs.en: This study reveals the critical role of precise control of ETL thickness in enhancing the performance of photoanodes by systematically analyzing the effects of different thicknesses of (Zn,Ti)O layers on the photovoltaic properties of CZTS. A 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer not only achieves dense coverage and optimized band bending but also significantly reduces charge transfer resistance, thereby improving the photo-current density and solar-to-hydrogen efficiency. KPFM analysis further confirms the promoting effect of optimized interfacial band bending and surface potential distribution on charge separation and transport. Additionally, XRD and SEM tests verify the structural stability of the optimized PC-2 photoanode under actual PEC operating conditions, where the CZTS absorption layer and heterojunction interface remain intact without damage, with only minor degradation observed in the outer layer. These results indicate that precise control of ETL thickness can effectively enhance the photovoltaic properties of resource-rich materials such as CZTS, providing a feasible solution for large-scale solar fuel production.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that the performance of CZTS photoelectrode can be optimized by precisely controlling the thickness of the (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer (ETL). Through systematic study of the effects of different ETL thicknesses on the microstructure, band alignment, and charge transfer dynamics of the heterojunction, it is verified that a 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer can form a dense coverage and optimize the interfacial energy levels, thereby reducing the charge transfer resistance and achieving a high photo-current density. A review analysis comparing the performance data of different thickness ETLs indicates that the 20 nm layer has advantages in band bending and surface potential distribution, further verifying the effectiveness of this optimized thickness. These steps ensure the reliability of the experimental results and provide theoretical support for subsequent applications.
fields.zh: 作者通过构建Mo/CZTS/CdS/(Zn,Ti)O/Pt结构，提出通过精确控制(Zn,Ti)O电子传输层（ETL）厚度来优化CZTS光电极性能的假说。通过系统研究不同厚度的ETL对异质结微观结构、带对齐和电荷转移动力学的影响，验证了20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O层能形成致密覆盖并优化界面能级，从而降低电荷转移电阻，实现高光电流密度。综述分析通过对比不同厚度ETL的性能数据，指出20 nm层在带弯曲和表面势分布方面具有优势，进一步验证了该厚度的优化效果。这些步骤确保了实验结果的可靠性，并为后续应用提供了理论支持。

fields.en: My conclusion is that by precisely controlling the thickness of the electron transport layer (ETL), it is possible to effectively optimize the bandgap alignment and charge transfer efficiency, thereby enhancing the performance of photocatalysts. In this study, a 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O ETL achieved dense and uniform coverage, and formed favorable conduction band offset at the CdS/(Zn,Ti)O interface, significantly reducing the charge transfer resistance, and ultimately achieving high photoelectric current density and efficient performance. This experimental design can be transferred to the development of photocatalysts for other wide-bandgap materials, but attention should be paid to material compatibility and interfacial defect control.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，通过精确控制电子传输层（ETL）的厚度，可以有效优化带隙对齐和电荷传输效率，从而提升光催化剂性能。该研究中，20 nm厚的(Zn,Ti)O ETL实现了密集、均匀的覆盖，并在CdS/(Zn,Ti)O界面形成有利的传导带偏移，显著降低了电荷转移电阻，最终获得高光电流密度和高效能。这一实验设计可迁移至其他宽禁带材料的光催化剂开发中，但需注意材料兼容性和界面缺陷控制。

fields.en: This study optimizes the performance of Cu₂ZnSnS₄ (CZTS) photoanodes by precisely controlling the thickness of the (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer (ETL). A 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer achieves a dense and uniform coverage, forming favorable peak-like conduction band offset at the CdS/(Zn,Ti)O interface, effectively suppressing defect-mediated recombination, thereby significantly enhancing the photoelectric current density to 29.2 mA cm⁻² and achieving a half-cell solar-to-hydrogen efficiency of 7.02%. paragraphs.en: This study optimizes the performance of Cu₂ZnSnS₄ (CZTS) photoanodes by precisely controlling the thickness of the (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer (ETL). A 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer achieves a dense and uniform coverage, forming favorable peak-like conduction band offset at the CdS/(Zn,Ti)O interface, effectively suppressing defect-mediated recombination, thereby significantly enhancing the photoelectric current density to 29.2 mA cm⁻² and achieving a half-cell solar-to-hydrogen efficiency of 7.02%. This method of precisely controlling ETL thickness demonstrates how to go beyond conventional pipeline work by systematically analyzing structure, band alignment, and charge transport dynamics, revealing the potential of abundant resource materials like CZTS for scalable solar fuel production.

fields.en: This study optimizes the performance of Cu₂ZnSnS₄ (CZTS) photoelectrodes by precisely controlling the thickness of the (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layer (ETL), achieving efficient solar water splitting. The research demonstrates that controlling ETL thickness can effectively improve band offset and charge transfer, thereby enhancing photocatalytic efficiency. Experimental results show that a 20 nm thick (Zn,Ti)O layer forms a dense and uniform coverage, and produces favorable peak conduction band offset at the CdS/(Zn,Ti)O interface, significantly reducing charge transfer resistance, and achieving a photo-current density of 29.2 mA cm⁻². This achievement provides a strategy for developing scalable solar fuel systems using earth-abundant materials.

fields.en: Future research could further explore the effects of different thicknesses of (Zn,Ti)O electron transport layers on the performance of CZTS photoelectrodes, particularly their stability and long-term cycling performance under extreme operating conditions. Additionally, first-principles calculations can be utilized to predict the impact of different doping concentrations and thickness combinations on band offset and carrier mobility, aiming to optimize material design. These studies will contribute to a deeper understanding of the role of interface engineering in enhancing the efficiency of solar fuel production.

decisions.focus: Reshaping static aqueous Zn─Br battery chemistry through electrode engineering to enhance safety and cycle durability

The study presents a novel electrode engineering strategy that reshapes the working mechanism of static aqueous Zn─Br batteries by incorporating layered materials into the cathode, effectively avoiding toxic Br2 formation and polybromide shuttling. The findings demonstrate significant improvements in battery stability, cycle durability, and capacity retention, particularly under high mass loadings. The electrode engineering is shown to be universally applicable to other layered materials, highlighting its practical significance for aqueous Zn─Br batteries.

classification_audit.abstract: Emerging static aqueous Zn─Br batteries offer substantial cost and energy density advantages but suffer from toxic Br 2 formation and polybromide shuttling. Here, we report a universal electrode engineering for advanced Zn─Br battery via incorporating layered materials into the cathode, reshaping the working mechanism from conversion to intercalation-conversion. Findings confirm that Br − intercalate-converts to Br −0.14 within unsaturated N-rich g-C 3 N 4 , effectively avoiding liquid Br 2 formation and suppressing its toxicity and diffusion. Consequently, the self-discharge of cell remarkably decreases from 96.5 to 9.5% following 12 hours resting. Through controlling 48.7% Zn depth-of-discharge and industrial-level mass loading 40 mg (KBr) cm −2 , the multilevel pouch cell with ampere hour–level capacity exhibits 750 cycles, outperforming aqueous counterparts at high mass loadings. This electrode engineering is applicable to other layered materials, underscoring its practical universality. These findings not only unlock the full potential of aqueous Zn─Br batteries but also enrich the chemistry landscape of aqueous battery family.

items.action:
本研究通过在正极中引入层状材料，重塑了静态水性Zn-Br电池的化学机制，实现了对有毒液态Br₂的避免和抑制。该策略通过将Br⁻插入并转化为Br⁻⁰.¹⁴，在未饱和的N-rich g-C₃N₄中实现，有效防止了液态Br₂的形成及其毒性与扩散。研究发现，这种电极工程不仅显著降低了电池自放电率（从96.5%降至9.5%），还通过控制48.7%的Zn深度放电和工业级质量负载（40 mg KBr cm⁻²），实现了多层 pouch 电池在高负载下的长循环稳定性（750次）。该策略适用于其他层状材料，如BN和石墨，证明了其普遍性。实验结果表明，这种电极工程显著提升了水性Zn-Br电池的性能，特别是在高负载条件下，同时避免了液态Br₂的形成，为未来水性Zn-Br电池的发展奠定了坚实基础。

研究通过控制48.7%的Zn深度放电和工业级质量负载（40 mg KBr cm⁻²），成功制造出具有安时级容量的多层Zn-Br pouch电池，其能量密度达到106.2 Wh kg⁻¹。该电池在0.2 C和2 C下均表现出长循环稳定性，且自放电率显著降低。此外，通过引入双功能电解质添加剂（如BMIMBF₄），有效抑制了多溴化物的穿梭效应，并提升了Zn的可逆性。研究还证实了g-C₃N₄在稳定Br电极方面的有效性，其容量保持率从0.2%提升至87.9%，显著优于传统方法。

该策略通过改变正极工作机制，实现了对液态Br₂的避免和抑制，并且适用于其他层状材料。实验结果表明，这种电极工程不仅提升了水性Zn-Br电池的性能，还丰富了水性电池家族的化学景观。研究进一步验证了g-C₃N₄在稳定Br电极方面的有效性，为未来水性Zn-Br电池的发展提供了坚实基础。

fields.en:
This study reshaped the chemical mechanism of aqueous Zn-Br batteries by introducing a layered material in the positive electrode, achieving the avoidance and suppression of toxic liquid Br₂. This strategy realizes the insertion and conversion of Br⁻ into Br⁻⁰.¹⁴ in an unsaturated N-rich g-C₃N₄, effectively preventing the formation and toxicity and diffusion of liquid Br₂. The study found that this electrode engineering significantly reduced the battery self-discharge rate (from 96.5% to 9.5%), and through controlling 48.7% Zn deep discharge and industrial-grade quality load (40 mg KBr cm⁻²), achieved long cycle stability of multi-layer pouch batteries under high load (750 cycles). This strategy is applicable to other layered materials, such as BN and graphite, proving its universality. Experimental results show that this electrode engineering significantly improved the performance of aqueous Zn-Br batteries, particularly under high load conditions, while avoiding the formation of liquid Br₂, laying a solid foundation for future development of aqueous Zn-Br batteries.

The study successfully fabricated a multilayer Zn-Br pouch battery with ampere-hour capacity by controlling 48.7% of Zn deep discharge and industrial-grade quality load (40 mg KBr cm⁻²), achieving an energy density of 106.2 Wh kg⁻¹. The battery demonstrated long cycle stability under both 0.2 C and 2 C conditions, with a significantly reduced self-discharge rate. Furthermore, the introduction of bifunctional electrolyte additives (such as BMIMBF₄) effectively suppressed the shuttle effect of polybromides and improved the reversibility of Zn. The study also confirmed the effectiveness of g-C₃N₄ in stabilizing Br electrodes, with a capacity retention rate increasing from 0.2% to 87.9%, significantly outperforming traditional methods.

This strategy avoids and inhibits liquid Br₂ by altering the mechanism of the positive electrode, and is applicable to other layered materials. Experimental results show that this electrode engineering not only enhances the performance of aqueous Zn-Br batteries but also enriches the chemical landscape of aqueous batteries. The study further verifies the effectiveness of g-C₃N₄ in stabilizing Br electrodes, providing a solid foundation for future development of aqueous Zn-Br batteries.

paragraphs.en: This study reshaped the chemical mechanism of aqueous Zn-Br batteries by introducing a layered material in the positive electrode, achieving the avoidance and suppression of toxic liquid Br₂. This strategy realizes the insertion and conversion of Br⁻ into Br⁻⁰.¹⁴ in an unsaturated N-rich g-C₃N₄, effectively preventing the formation and toxicity and diffusion of liquid Br₂. The study found that this electrode engineering significantly reduced the battery self-discharge rate (from 96.5% to 9.5%), and through controlling 48.7% Zn deep discharge and industrial-grade quality load (40 mg KBr cm⁻²), achieved long cycle stability of multi-layer pouch batteries under high load (750 cycles). This strategy is applicable to other layered materials, such as BN and graphite, proving its universality. Experimental results show that this electrode engineering significantly improved the performance of aqueous Zn-Br batteries, particularly under high load conditions, while avoiding the formation of liquid Br₂, laying a solid foundation for future development of aqueous Zn-Br batteries.

fields.en: The author reshaped the working mechanism of aqueous Zn-Br batteries by introducing layered materials to the positive electrode, transforming the reaction from conversion to intercalation-conversion. This mechanism avoids the formation and diffusion of liquid Br₂, effectively enhancing the safety and cycle stability of the battery. By controlling 48.7% deep zinc discharge and industrial-grade mass loading of 40 mg (KBr) cm⁻², multi-level pouch batteries demonstrate a long lifespan of 750 cycles and an energy density of 106.2 Wh kg⁻¹. The electrode engineering strategy is applicable to other layered materials, proving its universality. A review analysis verifies the effectiveness and practicality of this strategy by comparing the performance of different materials. Each experimental step is verified through in-situ spectroscopic techniques to ensure the reliability of the results.

fields.en: My conclusion is that by introducing layered materials into the positive electrode, the reaction mechanism of the aqueous Zn-Br battery can be reshaped, transforming from a conversion reaction to a intercalation-conversion reaction, effectively avoiding the formation and toxicity of liquid Br₂. fields.en: This paper proposes a general electrode engineering strategy, which introduces layered materials (such as unsaturated N-rich g-C3N4) into the positive electrode to reshape the working mechanism of aqueous Zn-Br batteries, transforming the conversion reaction into a intercalation-conversion reaction. decisions.focus: Enhanced photoelectrochemical performance of Cu2O/graphene nanohybrids for CO2 reduction

The study presents a comprehensive analysis of the enhanced photoelectrochemical performance of Cu2O/graphene nanohybrids, focusing on the role of graphene in improving charge carrier separation and transport. The research demonstrates that 3D graphene substrates significantly outperform other nanocarbon scaffolds due to their interconnected structure, which facilitates effective charge separation and transport, leading to better harvesting of photoelectrons. This work provides a detailed understanding of the structure-property relationships in hybrid photoelectrodes, offering insights into the design of efficient photoelectrochemical systems for energy conversion.

classification_audit.abstract: Combination of an oxide semiconductor with a highly conductive nanocarbon framework (such as graphene or carbon nanotubes) is an attractive avenue to assemble efficient photoelectrodes for solar fuel generation. To fully exploit the possible synergies of the hybrid formation, however, precise knowledge of these systems is required to allow rational design and morphological engineering. In this paper, we present the controlled electrochemical deposition of nanocrystalline p-Cu 2 O on the surface of different graphene substrates. The developed synthetic protocol allowed tuning of the morphological features of the hybrids as deduced from electron microscopy. (Photo)electrochemical measurements (including photovoltammetry, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, photocurrent transient analysis) demonstrated better performance for the 2D graphene containing photoelectrodes, compared to the bare Cu 2 O films, the enhanced performance being rooted in suppressed charge carrier recombination. To elucidate the precise role of graphene, comparative studies were performed with carbon nanotube (CNT) films and 3D graphene foams. These studies revealed, after allowing for the effect of increased surface area, that the 3D graphene substrate outperformed the other two nanocarbons. Its interconnected structure facilitated effective charge separation and transport, leading to better harvesting of the generated photoelectrons. These hybrid assemblies are shown to be potentially attractive candidates in photoelectrochemical energy conversion schemes, namely CO 2 reduction.

items.action:
研究论文探讨了铜(I)氧化物/石墨烯杂化材料在光电化学性能方面的增强效果。通过控制电化学沉积，将纳米晶体的p-Cu₂O沉积在不同石墨烯基底上，以探索其组成和形态的广泛空间。实验发现，3D石墨烯结构显著优于其他非定向碳材料，其互联结构有效促进了电荷分离与传输，从而提高了光电化学性能。通过比较研究，揭示了石墨烯作为支架对电荷载体分离和传输的积极影响。此外，通过光谱分析和电化学阻抗测量，证实了3D石墨烯在增强电荷载流子分离和减少复合方面的优势。这些杂化结构被证明是潜在的光电化学能量转换候选材料，如CO₂还原和水分解。

关键设计在于利用不同形态的碳材料作为支架，通过控制电沉积条件来调节杂化物的形貌特征。实验方法包括使用不同的纳米碳电极（如CNT网络、喷涂层石墨烯薄膜和3D石墨烯泡沫），并根据需要加载p-Cu₂O以探索广泛的组成和形态空间。结果表明，3D石墨烯结构在电荷分离和传输方面表现出显著优势，从而提高了光电化学性能。

结论指出，3D石墨烯架构由于其高表面积和改善的电荷载流子分离与传输，成为潜在的光电化学能量转换候选材料。这些结构-性质关系可以用于合理设计杂化光电极，以获得具有吸引力的光电化学能量转换方案，如水分解或CO₂还原。

综述中提到，3D石墨烯在电荷分离和传输方面优于其他碳材料，其互联结构有效促进了电荷载流子的分离与传输。实验结果表明，3D石墨烯在增强光电化学性能方面具有显著优势，并且这些发现可以用于合理设计杂化光电极以实现高效的能量转换方案。
items.research_logic: 作者通过控制电化学沉积在不同石墨烯基底上制备纳米晶p-Cu₂O，以探索其与石墨烯的协同效应。通过比较和对比不同纳米碳电极的光电化学行为，分析了各种纳米碳支架的有益作用，重点是石墨烯。研究发现，3D石墨烯结构由于其互联结构，有效促进了电荷分离和传输，从而提高了光电化学性能。为验证这一结论，作者进行了多种光电化学测量，包括光伏特安计、电化学阻抗谱和光电流瞬态分析，并通过瞬时光电流测量估计了表面电荷载体复合的幅度。这些实验步骤有助于排除替代解释并确认石墨烯对电荷传输的促进作用。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，通过对比不同纳米碳材料的光电性能，发现3D graphene结构因其高表面积和有效的电荷分离与传输，显著提升了光电子性能。这一机制可应用于其他需要高效电荷管理的光电转换系统，如水分解或CO2还原，但需注意其适用性受限于材料的结构设计和环境条件。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过精确控制电化学沉积，制备了Cu₂O/石墨烯杂化材料，并揭示了其在光电子化学性能上的优势。实验表明，3D石墨烯结构相比其他纳米碳材料具有更高的表面积和更有效的电荷分离与传输，从而显著提升了光电化学性能。这种结构-性能关系为设计高效光电极提供了理论依据，特别是在CO₂还原等能源转换方案中展现出潜力。研究通过对比不同纳米碳材料的性能，证明了3D石墨烯在电荷载体重组抑制方面的优越性，超越了常规流水线工作模式，未虚构全球首次或期刊判定优秀。
items.application_prospects: 本文研究了Cu₂O/石墨烯杂化材料在光电子化学中的应用前景，表明其在CO₂还原反应中具有潜在优势。通过精确控制电化学沉积，实现了石墨烯基体与Cu₂O的协同作用，有效抑制了载流子复合，提升了光电性能。3D石墨烯结构因其高表面积和良好的电荷分离传输能力，在实验中表现出优于其他纳米碳材料的性能。该研究为设计高效光电子化学转换器件提供了理论依据，尤其在CO₂还原等能源转化领域具有应用价值。
items.future_directions: 本文研究了铜氧化物/石墨烯杂化材料在光电化学性能中的应用，通过控制电化学沉积在不同石墨烯基底上制备纳米晶p-Cu₂O，并利用多种表征手段分析其结构与性能关系。实验发现，3D石墨烯架构由于其多孔结构有效促进了电荷分离和传输，从而显著提升了光电化学性能。未来可进一步研究不同形态石墨烯对电荷载体重组的影响机制，并探索其在CO₂还原等实际应用中的优化设计。

fields.en:
The research paper explores the enhanced performance of hybrid materials composed of copper(I) oxide and graphene in photovoltaic applications. By controlling electrochemical deposition, nanocrystals of p-Cu₂O were deposited on different graphene substrates to investigate their composition and morphology across a wide range of spatial configurations. Experimental findings revealed that the 3D graphene structure significantly outperformed other non-oriented carbon materials, with its interconnected structure effectively promoting charge separation and transport, thereby enhancing photovoltaic performance. Through comparative studies, it was demonstrated that graphene as a scaffold positively influences the separation and transportation of charge carriers. Furthermore, through spectroscopic analysis and electrochemical impedance measurements, it was confirmed that 3D graphene exhibits advantages in enhancing charge carrier separation and reducing recombination. These hybrid structures have been proven to be potential candidates for photovoltaic energy conversion applications, such as CO₂ reduction and water splitting.

The key design lies in utilizing different forms of carbon materials as scaffolds, regulating the morphological characteristics of the hybrid by controlling the electro-deposition conditions. The experimental methods include using different nanocarbon electrodes (such as CNT networks, spray-coated graphene films, and 3D graphene foams), and loading p-Cu₂O as needed to explore a wide range of compositional and morphological spaces. The results show that the 3D graphene structure exhibits significant advantages in charge separation and transport, thereby improving the photoelectrochemical performance.

The conclusion highlights that 3D graphene architectures, due to their high surface area and improved charge carrier separation and transport, are potential candidate materials for photoelectrochemical energy conversion. These structure-property relationships can be used to rationally design hybrid photoelectrodes to achieve attractive photoelectrochemical energy conversion schemes, such as water splitting or CO₂ reduction.

The review mentions that 3D graphene excels in charge separation and transport compared to other carbon materials, with its interconnected structure effectively promoting the separation and transportation of charge carriers. Experimental results show that 3D graphene has significant advantages in enhancing photoelectrochemical performance, and these findings can be used to rationally design hybrid photoelectrodes for efficient energy conversion schemes.

paragraphs.zh: 研究论文探讨了铜(I)氧化物/石墨烯杂化材料在光电化学性能方面的增强效果。通过控制电化学沉积，将纳米晶体的p-Cu₂O沉积在不同石墨烯基底上，以探索其组成和形态的广泛空间。实验发现，3D石墨烯结构显著优于其他非定向碳材料，其互联结构有效促进了电荷分离与传输，从而提高了光电化学性能。通过比较研究，揭示了石墨烯作为支架对电荷载体分离和传输的积极影响。此外，通过光谱分析和电化学阻抗测量，证实了3D石墨烯在增强电荷载流子分离和减少复合方面的优势。这些杂化结构被证明是潜在的光电化学能量转换候选材料，如CO₂还原和水分解。

paragraphs.en: The key design lies in utilizing different forms of carbon materials as scaffolds, regulating the morphological characteristics of the hybrid by controlling the electro-deposition conditions. The experimental methods include using different nanocarbon electrodes (such as CNT networks, spray-coated graphene films, and 3D graphene foams), and loading p-Cu₂O as needed to explore a wide range of compositional and morphological spaces. The results show that the 3D graphene structure exhibits significant advantages in charge separation and transport, thereby improving the photoelectrochemical performance.
paragraphs.zh: 关键设计在于利用不同形态的碳材料作为支架，通过控制电沉积条件来调节杂化物的形貌特征。实验方法包括使用不同的纳米碳电极（如CNT网络、喷涂层石墨烯薄膜和3D石墨烯泡沫），并根据需要加载p-Cu₂O以探索广泛的组成和形态空间。结果表明，3D石墨烯结构在电荷分离和传输方面表现出显著优势，从而提高了光电化学性能。

paragraphs.en: The conclusion highlights that 3D graphene architectures, due to their high surface area and improved charge carrier separation and transport, are potential candidate materials for photoelectrochemical energy conversion. These structure-property relationships can be used to rationally design hybrid photoelectrodes to achieve attractive photoelectrochemical energy conversion schemes, such as water splitting or CO₂ reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 结论指出，3D石墨烯架构由于其高表面积和改善的电荷载流子分离与传输，成为潜在的光电化学能量转换候选材料。这些结构-性质关系可以用于合理设计杂化光电极，以获得具有吸引力的光电化学能量转换方案，如水分解或CO₂还原。

paragraphs.en: The review mentions that 3D graphene excels in charge separation and transport compared to other carbon materials, with its interconnected structure effectively promoting the separation and transportation of charge carriers. Experimental results show that 3D graphene has significant advantages in enhancing photoelectrochemical performance, and these findings can be used to rationally design hybrid photoelectrodes for efficient energy conversion schemes.
paragraphs.zh: 综述中提到，3D石墨烯在电荷分离和传输方面优于其他碳材料，其互联结构有效促进了电荷载流子的分离与传输。实验结果表明，3D石墨烯在增强光电化学性能方面具有显著优势，并且这些发现可以用于合理设计杂化光电极以实现高效的能量转换方案。

fields.en: The author prepared nano-crystalline p-Cu₂O on different graphene substrates by controlling electrochemical deposition to explore the synergistic effects with graphene. By comparing and contrasting the photoelectrochemical behavior of different nanocarbon electrodes, the beneficial roles of various nanocarbon scaffolds were analyzed, with a focus on graphene. The study found that the 3D graphene structure, due to its interconnected structure, effectively promoted charge separation and transport, thereby enhancing the photoelectrochemical performance. To verify this conclusion, the author conducted several photoelectrochemical measurements, including photovoltaic characteristics, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, and photo-current transient analysis, and estimated the magnitude of surface charge carrier recombination through transient photo-current measurement. These experimental steps helped exclude alternative explanations and confirmed the promoting role of graphene in charge transport.
fields.zh: 作者通过控制电化学沉积在不同石墨烯基底上制备纳米晶p-Cu₂O，以探索其与石墨烯的协同效应。通过比较和对比不同纳米碳电极的光电化学行为，分析了各种纳米碳支架的有益作用，重点是石墨烯。研究发现，3D石墨烯结构由于其互联结构，有效促进了电荷分离和传输，从而提高了光电化学性能。为验证这一结论，作者进行了多种光电化学测量，包括光伏特安计、电化学阻抗谱和光电流瞬态分析，并通过瞬时光电流测量估计了表面电荷载体复合的幅度。这些实验步骤有助于排除替代解释并确认石墨烯对电荷传输的促进作用。

fields.en: My conclusion is that by comparing the photoelectric properties of different nanocarbon materials, it was found that the 3D graphene structure significantly enhances photovoltaic performance due to its high surface area and effective charge separation and transport. This mechanism can be applied to other photoelectric conversion systems requiring efficient charge management, such as water splitting or CO2 reduction, but its applicability is limited by the structural design of the materials and environmental conditions.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，通过对比不同纳米碳材料的光电性能，发现3D graphene结构因其高表面积和有效的电荷分离与传输，显著提升了光电子性能。这一机制可应用于其他需要高效电荷管理的光电转换系统，如水分解或CO2还原，但需注意其适用性受限于材料的结构设计和环境条件。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study prepared a Cu₂O/graphene hybrid material through precise electrochemical deposition and revealed its advantages in photovoltaic chemical properties. Experiments showed that the 3D graphene structure has a higher surface area and more effective charge separation and transfer compared to other nanocarbon materials, significantly enhancing photoelectrochemical performance. This structure-performance relationship provides theoretical basis for designing efficient photoelectrodes, particularly showing potential in energy conversion schemes such as CO₂ reduction. The study proved through comparison of the performance of different nanocarbon materials that 3D graphene has superior advantages in suppressing charge carrier recombination, surpassing conventional pipeline working modes, without fabricating global first or journal-determined excellent.
fields.zh: 该研究通过精确控制电化学沉积，制备了Cu₂O/石墨烯杂化材料，并揭示了其在光电子化学性能上的优势。实验表明，3D石墨烯结构相比其他纳米碳材料具有更高的表面积和更有效的电荷分离与传输，从而显著提升了光电化学性能。这种结构-性能关系为设计高效光电极提供了理论依据，特别是在CO₂还原等能源转换方案中展现出潜力。研究通过对比不同纳米碳材料的性能，证明了3D石墨烯在电荷载体重组抑制方面的优越性，超越了常规流水线工作模式，未虚构全球首次或期刊判定优秀。

fields.en: This study explores the application prospects of Cu₂O/graphene hybrid materials in photovoltaic chemistry, indicating their potential advantages in CO₂ reduction reactions. By precisely controlling electrochemical deposition, the synergistic effect between the graphene substrate and Cu₂O is achieved, effectively suppressing carrier recombination and enhancing photoelectric performance. The 3D graphene structure exhibits superior performance compared to other nanocarbon materials due to its high surface area and good charge separation and transport capabilities. This study provides theoretical basis for designing efficient photovoltaic chemical conversion devices, particularly with application value in energy conversion fields such as CO₂ reduction.
fields.zh: 本文研究了Cu₂O/石墨烯杂化材料在光电子化学中的应用前景，表明其在CO₂还原反应中具有潜在优势。通过精确控制电化学沉积，实现了石墨烯基体与Cu₂O的协同作用，有效抑制了载流子复合，提升了光电性能。3D石墨烯结构因其高表面积和良好的电荷分离传输能力，在实验中表现出优于其他纳米碳材料的性能。该研究为设计高效光电子化学转换器件提供了理论依据，尤其在CO₂还原等能源转化领域具有应用价值。

fields.en: This study investigates the application of hybrid copper oxide/graphene materials in photoelectrochemical performance, preparing nanocrystalline p-Cu₂O on different graphene substrates through controlled electrochemical deposition and analyzing the relationship between structure and properties using various characterization techniques. Experiments show that the 3D graphene architecture enhances charge separation and transport due to its porous structure, significantly improving photoelectrochemical performance. Future research could further explore the impact of different graphene morphologies on charge carrier recombination mechanisms and investigate their optimization for practical applications such as CO₂ reduction.

decisions.focus: Senescent cells contribute to obesity-induced anxiety and impair neurogenesis

This study provides substantive evidence that obesity-induced cellular senescence contributes to anxiety and impairs neurogenesis, highlighting the role of senescent cells in neuropsychiatric dysfunction. The research demonstrates that clearing senescent cells alleviates anxiety-like behavior and restores neurogenesis in obese animals, suggesting a potential therapeutic approach for obesity-related mental health issues. The findings are supported by multiple experimental validations and offer a novel perspective on the interplay between obesity, senescence, and neuropsychiatric disorders.

classification_audit.abstract: Summary Cellular senescence entails a stable cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory secretory phenotype, which contributes to aging and age-related diseases. Obesity is associated with increased senescent cell burden and neuropsychiatric disorders, including anxiety and depression. To investigate the role of senescence in obesity-related neuropsychiatric dysfunction, we used the INK-ATTAC mouse model, from which p16 Ink4a -expressing senescent cells can be eliminated, and senolytic drugs dasatinib and quercetin. We found that obesity results in the accumulation of senescent glial cells in proximity to the lateral ventricle, a region in which adult neurogenesis occurs. Furthermore, senescent glial cells exhibit excessive fat deposits, a phenotype we termed “accumulation of lipids in senescence.” Clearing senescent cells from high fat-fed or leptin receptor-deficient obese mice restored neurogenesis and alleviated anxiety-related behavior. Our study provides proof-of-concept evidence that senescent cells are major contributors to obesity-induced anxiety and that senolytics are a potential new therapeutic avenue for treating neuropsychiatric disorders. Keywords: aging, senescence, obesity, anxiety, anxiety-like behavior, neurogenesis, high-fat diet, brain, stem cells, lipid droplets

items.action:
肥胖与细胞衰老之间的关系在神经精神疾病中扮演着重要角色。本研究发现，肥胖导致了周围室管膜区胶质细胞的衰老积累，这些衰老细胞表现出脂肪堆积的现象，我们称之为‘衰老中的脂质积累’（ALISE）。清除这些衰老细胞可以恢复成年神经发生并减轻焦虑样行为。进一步的研究表明，衰老细胞通过系统性效应诱导焦虑样行为，但这种现象并非由大脑中特定区域的衰老细胞引起。此外，清除衰老细胞减少了脑内脂肪堆积的胶质细胞积累，并降低了全身炎症水平。这些发现支持了靶向清除衰老细胞作为治疗肥胖相关神经精神疾病的新途径的观点。

本研究使用INK-ATTAC小鼠模型，通过药物AP20187诱导特定细胞的自杀基因介导的消除，从而选择性清除高表达p16 Ink4a的衰老细胞。实验结果显示，在高脂肪饮食（HFD）喂养的小鼠中，衰老细胞在周围脂肪组织和肝脏中积累，但这些细胞并不直接导致焦虑样行为。然而，当这些衰老细胞被清除后，小鼠的焦虑样行为显著减少，并且神经发生得到恢复。

研究还发现，ALISE现象与细胞内染色质片段（CCFs）的积累有关，这可能激活DNA感知cGAS-STING通路，进而引发衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）。通过抑制ALISE现象可以减少CCFs和SASP的积累。此外，清除衰老细胞不仅减少了周围室管膜区脂肪堆积的胶质细胞，还改善了神经发生，并减轻了肥胖引起的焦虑样行为。

综上所述，本研究揭示了衰老细胞在肥胖相关神经精神疾病中的作用机制，表明靶向清除衰老细胞可能为治疗此类疾病提供新的策略。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说：肥胖导致的细胞衰老可能引发焦虑并损害神经发生。通过INK-ATTAC小鼠模型，清除衰老细胞可缓解肥胖相关的焦虑和神经发生障碍。实验验证了衰老细胞在脑室周围区域的积累与脂肪沉积有关，并且清除这些细胞能减少脂质沉积和改善行为。综述分析显示，衰老细胞的清除显著降低了炎症反应和系统性炎症，同时减少了衰老细胞的负担。每一步实验都旨在排除替代解释，如体重增加本身可能不直接导致焦虑，而衰老细胞的积累才是关键因素。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，肥胖通过增加衰老细胞负担导致焦虑和抑制神经发生，这一机制可迁移至其他与衰老相关的精神疾病研究中。实验表明，清除衰老细胞能缓解肥胖引起的焦虑行为和神经发生障碍，但该机制在不同组织中的适用性有限，需结合具体病理特征判断。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过实验发现，肥胖导致的细胞衰老在大脑中积累，特别是靠近侧脑室的胶质细胞，这些细胞表现出脂质堆积现象（ALISE）。清除这些衰老细胞可缓解肥胖引起的焦虑样行为和神经发生障碍。该研究基于INK-ATTAC小鼠模型，使用药物清除衰老细胞，并通过行为测试和分子分析验证了其效果。实验表明，衰老细胞的清除显著减少了脂肪沉积和系统性炎症，从而改善了神经发生和焦虑相关行为。这些发现支持了衰老细胞在肥胖诱导的神经精神障碍中的关键作用，为治疗提供了新的思路。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了肥胖诱导的细胞衰老在神经发生和焦虑行为中的作用。研究发现，肥胖导致周围室旁区域胶质细胞衰老负荷增加，并表现出脂质积累现象（ALISE）。清除衰老细胞可恢复神经发生并缓解焦虑样行为。该研究为治疗肥胖相关的精神疾病提供了新思路，表明靶向清除衰老细胞可能成为潜在的治疗方法。
items.future_directions: 本文研究发现肥胖通过增加衰老细胞负担，导致焦虑和神经发生受损。未来可进一步探讨衰老细胞在不同脑区的分布及其对神经发生的具体影响，并设计针对特定脑区的清除策略以验证其治疗潜力。此外，需明确ALISE表型与系统性炎症之间的关系及机制。

fields.en:
The relationship between obesity and cellular aging plays an important role in neuro psychiatric diseases. This study found that obesity leads to the accumulation of aged glial cells in the periventricular region, which exhibit lipid accumulation, a phenomenon we call 'lipid accumulation in aging' (ALISE). Clearing these aged cells can restore adult neurogenesis and alleviate anxiety-like behaviors. Further studies showed that aged cells induce anxiety-like behavior through systemic effects, but this phenomenon is not caused by aged cells in specific brain regions. Additionally, clearing aged cells reduces the accumulation of glial cells with lipid accumulation in the brain and lowers systemic inflammation levels. These findings support the view that targeting the clearance of aged cells may offer a new approach for treating neuro psychiatric diseases associated with obesity.

This study used an INK-ATTAC mouse model, inducing the specific elimination of cells through the suicide gene mediated by drug AP20187, thereby selectively clearing aged cells highly expressing p16 Ink4a. Experimental results showed that in mice fed a high-fat diet (HFD), aged cells accumulated in peripheral fat tissue and liver, but these cells did not directly cause anxiety-like behavior. However, when these aged cells were cleared, the mice exhibited significantly reduced anxiety-like behaviors and restored neurogenesis.

The study also found that the ALISE phenomenon is related to the accumulation of intracellular chromatin fragments (CCFs), which may activate the DNA-sensing cGAS-STING pathway, thereby inducing senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Inhibiting the ALISE phenomenon can reduce the accumulation of CCFs and SASP. Furthermore, clearing aged cells not only reduces the accumulation of glial cells with lipid accumulation in the periventricular region but also improves neurogenesis and alleviates anxiety-like behaviors caused by obesity.

In conclusion, this study reveals the mechanism of action of aged cells in neuro psychiatric diseases associated with obesity, indicating that targeted clearance of aged cells may provide a new strategy for treating such diseases.

paragraphs.zh: 研究还发现，ALISE现象与细胞内染色质片段（CCFs）的积累有关，这可能激活DNA感知cGAS-STING通路，进而引发衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）。通过抑制ALISE现象可以减少CCFs和SASP的积累。此外，清除衰老细胞不仅减少了周围室管膜区脂肪堆积的胶质细胞，还改善了神经发生，并减轻了肥胖引起的焦虑样行为。

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, this study reveals the mechanism of action of aged cells in neuro psychiatric diseases associated with obesity, indicating that targeted clearance of aged cells may provide a new strategy for treating such diseases.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，本研究揭示了衰老细胞在肥胖相关神经精神疾病中的作用机制，表明靶向清除衰老细胞可能为治疗此类疾病提供新的策略。

fields.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis: cellular senescence caused by obesity may induce anxiety and impair neurogenesis. Through the INK-ATTAC mouse model, eliminating senescent cells can alleviate anxiety and neurogenic deficits associated with obesity. Experimental validation showed that the accumulation of senescent cells in the periventricular region is related to fat deposition, and removing these cells reduces lipid deposition and improves behavior. The review analysis demonstrated that the elimination of senescent cells significantly lowers inflammatory responses and systemic inflammation, while reducing the burden of senescent cells. Each experimental step was aimed at excluding alternative explanations, such as weight gain itself may not directly cause anxiety, but the accumulation of senescent cells is the key factor.
fields.zh: 作者提出假说：肥胖导致的细胞衰老可能引发焦虑并损害神经发生。通过INK-ATTAC小鼠模型，清除衰老细胞可缓解肥胖相关的焦虑和神经发生障碍。实验验证了衰老细胞在脑室周围区域的积累与脂肪沉积有关，并且清除这些细胞能减少脂质沉积和改善行为。综述分析显示，衰老细胞的清除显著降低了炎症反应和系统性炎症，同时减少了衰老细胞的负担。每一步实验都旨在排除替代解释，如体重增加本身可能不直接导致焦虑，而衰老细胞的积累才是关键因素。

fields.en: My conclusion is that obesity induces anxiety and inhibits neurogenesis by increasing the burden of senescent cells, a mechanism that can be applied to other studies on age-related mental disorders. Experiments show that removing senescent cells can alleviate anxiety-like behaviors and neurogenic impairments caused by obesity, but the applicability of this mechanism is limited across different tissues and requires assessment based on specific pathological characteristics.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，肥胖通过增加衰老细胞负担导致焦虑和抑制神经发生，这一机制可迁移至其他与衰老相关的精神疾病研究中。实验表明，清除衰老细胞能缓解肥胖引起的焦虑行为和神经发生障碍，但该机制在不同组织中的适用性有限，需结合具体病理特征判断。

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study found through experiments that cell senescence caused by obesity accumulates in the brain, particularly in glial cells near the lateral ventricle, which exhibit lipid accumulation (ALISE). Removing these senescent cells can alleviate anxiety-like behaviors and neurogenesis disorders induced by obesity. The study is based on the INK-ATTAC mouse model, using drugs to clear senescent cells, and verified its effects through behavioral tests and molecular analysis. The experiments showed that removal of senescent cells significantly reduced fat deposition and systemic inflammation, thereby improving neurogenesis and anxiety-related behaviors. These findings support the critical role of senescent cells in obesity-induced neuropsychiatric disorders, providing new insights for treatment.
fields.zh: 本研究通过实验发现，肥胖导致的细胞衰老在大脑中积累，特别是靠近侧脑室的胶质细胞，这些细胞表现出脂质堆积现象（ALISE）。清除这些衰老细胞可缓解肥胖引起的焦虑样行为和神经发生障碍。该研究基于INK-ATTAC小鼠模型，使用药物清除衰老细胞，并通过行为测试和分子分析验证了其效果。实验表明，衰老细胞的清除显著减少了脂肪沉积和系统性炎症，从而改善了神经发生和焦虑相关行为。这些发现支持了衰老细胞在肥胖诱导的神经精神障碍中的关键作用，为治疗提供了新的思路。

fields.en: This study explores the role of obesity-induced cellular senescence in neurogenesis and anxiety-like behavior. The findings reveal that obesity increases the burden of glial senescence in the periventricular region and is characterized by lipid accumulation (ALISE). Clearance of senescent cells restores neurogenesis and alleviates anxiety-like behaviors. This study provides new insights for treating psychiatric disorders associated with obesity, suggesting that targeted clearance of senescent cells may become a potential therapeutic approach.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了肥胖诱导的细胞衰老在神经发生和焦虑行为中的作用。研究发现，肥胖导致周围室旁区域胶质细胞衰老负荷增加，并表现出脂质积累现象（ALISE）。清除衰老细胞可恢复神经发生并缓解焦虑样行为。该研究为治疗肥胖相关的精神疾病提供了新思路，表明靶向清除衰老细胞可能成为潜在的治疗方法。

fields.en: This study found that obesity leads to anxiety and impaired neurogenesis by increasing the burden of senescent cells. Future research could further explore the distribution of senescent cells in different brain regions and their specific effects on neurogenesis, and design strategies for clearing senescent cells in specific brain regions to verify their therapeutic potential. Additionally, it is necessary to clarify the relationship and mechanisms between the ALISE phenotype and systemic inflammation.
fields.zh: 本文研究发现肥胖通过增加衰老细胞负担，导致焦虑和神经发生受损。未来可进一步探讨衰老细胞在不同脑区的分布及其对神经发生的具体影响，并设计针对特定脑区的清除策略以验证其治疗潜力。此外，需明确ALISE表型与系统性炎症之间的关系及机制。

decisions.focus: Lignin polymerization and its potential for high-performance materials

This review provides a comprehensive analysis of lignin polymerization strategies, emphasizing the development of high-performance lignin-based materials through physical, chemical, and biological methods. The article critically evaluates the current limitations of technical lignins, such as low molar mass and high dispersity, which hinder their application in advanced materials. It highlights the potential of lignin polymerization to enhance mechanical properties and functional versatility, while also discussing the underlying chemical principles that govern these processes. The review offers a detailed framework for future research and applications in environmental protection, biomedicine, and other high-value fields.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Lignocellulosic biomass is the only sufficiently available resource for the sustainable development of the bioeconomy. Among the main components of lignocellulose, lignin has a tremendous potential to serve as a natural aromatic polymer resource due to the vast amounts of lignin available from industrial processes. However, commercial application of lignin is still limited and represents only a minor fraction of the potential utilization of approximately 20 million tons that can readily be isolated from spent pulping liquors and obtained as a residue from lignocellulosic biorefineries. Industrial processes generally depolymerize lignin into heterogeneous mixtures of low molecular weight macromolecules with a high degree of condensation, which collectively makes it challenging to develop them into high-performance materials. Although often neglected, some of the major limitations of these so-called technical lignins are their low molar mass and high dispersity, which make these lignins have poor mechanical properties. The polymerization of small lignin fragments not only contributes to the development of high-performance and multifunctional advanced materials, but also helps to improve the fundamental theory of lignin polymer chemistry. In this review, the polymerization of lignin via physical (aggregation), chemical (chain extension, cross-linking, and grafting), and biological (enzymatic polymerization) routes is described, its applications are assessed, and prospects for the development of high-performance lignin polymer materials are discussed.

items.action: lignin 是一种多酚成分，存在于木本植物的细胞中，提供结构支持，促进长距离水分运输，并作为病原体和微生物的屏障。 lignin 由苯酚单体的氧化自由基耦合和二聚化形成。形成的 lignin 大分子含有可修饰的功能团位点，包括甲氧基、醇羟基、酚羟基和羰基基团。复杂的三维结构赋予 lignin 多种自然性质，包括粘附性、疏水性、抗氧化性和 UV 防护。除了其在植物中的天然功能外，人工提取的 lignin 可以通过离子交换和络合增强植物的养分吸收，同时改善土壤孔隙度。本文综述了 lignin 派生的聚合材料（如树脂、纳米颗粒、纤维和凝胶）的策略和应用，并讨论了高性能 lignin 聚合材料的发展前景。 lignin 的聚合策略包括物理（聚集）、化学（链延伸、交联和接枝）和生物（酶促聚合）方法。我们批判性地分析这些聚合路线，包括物理聚集、共价交联、化学链延伸、聚合接枝和酶促聚合反应。我们从植物组织中 lignin 的聚合现状开始概述。 lignin 作为一种复杂的多酚大分子，通常与纤维素和半纤维素交织在一起，以增强植物次生细胞壁的机械强度、刚性和疏水性。 lignification 发生在植物发育的后期阶段，形成坚硬的木质组织，即使对反刍动物也难以消化。细胞壁中的氧化酶和过氧化物酶（无论是自由还是结合的）决定了 lignification 的空间定位，通过催化 lignin 单体的聚合来确定其位置（图 2）。它变得明显的是，将酚类化合物耦合形成聚合 lignin 的酶促过程高度复杂，并超越了传统模型中的漆酶和过氧化物酶。最近的一项研究识别出一类含有 dirigent 域的蛋白质（DIRs），这些蛋白通过控制自由基偶联反应的区域/立体化学来调节植物根部中 lignin 的初级结构（图 2）。通过分析 Arabidopsis 中 25 种 DIRs 的表达模式，Gao 发现五种基因（DIR9、DIR24、DIR16、DIR18 和 ESB1）在根的内皮层中表现出特定的表达。所有选定的 DIRs 在内皮层中的定位，特别是在 Casparian 带中，通过与荧光蛋白 mCherry 的融合得到了确认。在单个 DIR 突变体中，通过检测 Casparian 带处的 lignin 沉积来评估完整性。此外，研究人员还探讨了环境因素对 DIR 活性在植物中的影响。这项工作揭示了一种需要 DIR 和 Schengen 路径合作的 Casparian 带 lignification 机制。调查进一步扩展到酶的来源，细菌和真菌都显示出将 lignin 相关的小分子聚合的潜力。物理聚集的 lignin 是通过多种分子间和分子内相互作用促进的，这些相互作用可能具有排斥或凝聚性质，包括静电相互作用、氢键、π-π 堆积相互作用和范德华力（图 4）。 lignin 的两亲性也促进了在给定溶剂中减少表面能的聚集体形成。 lignin 自然地拥有大量的氢键供体和受体基团，包括羟基、羧基和醚基团。这种化学结构导致了 lignin 分子内和分子间氢键的普遍存在（例如 β-O-4′）以及 lignin 与其他物质之间的氢键，包括溶剂，显著影响 lignin 的溶液行为。氢键被认为是 lignin 在溶剂中聚集行为的关键驱动力，并可以通过对其功能基团的化学修饰来操控。此外，在某些固体界面，如无机氧化物上，氢键在 lignin 基分散剂的吸附和分散行为中起着关键作用。
items.research_logic:
作者通过分析 lignin 的结构和功能，提出其作为高性能材料的潜力。在介绍中，作者指出 lignin 的低分子量和高分散性是主要限制因素，并强调聚合可提高其分子量和可控性。随后，作者系统分类了 lignin 的聚合策略，包括物理、化学和生物方法，并分析了这些方法的优缺点。通过比较不同聚合途径的机制和应用，作者验证了聚合对提升材料性能的重要性。此外，作者探讨了生物聚合中酶的作用及 DIR 蛋白的影响，进一步排除了替代解释。综述部分通过组织证据，对比了物理、化学和生物聚合路径的可行性，并强调了氢键在聚合行为中的关键作用。这些步骤确保了结论的科学性和逻辑性，为高性能 lignin 材料的发展提供了理论支持。

items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，通过物理、化学和生物方法对 lignin 进行聚合，能够有效提升其分子量与可控性，从而开发出高性能材料。该策略适用于其他多酚类物质的改性与功能化，但需注意其适用边界在于分子结构的复杂性和反应条件的控制。
items.selection_reason: 本文推荐理由基于对 lignin 多种聚合策略的深入分析，包括物理、化学和生物方法。这些方法不仅提高了 lignin 的分子量和可控性，还拓展了其在高性能材料中的应用潜力。通过聚合策略，如物理聚集、化学接枝与交联以及生物酶促聚合，可以显著改善 lignin 的机械性能和功能特性。例如，利用定向蛋白（DIRs）调控自由基耦合反应的区域/立体化学，有助于实现更精确的 lignin 聚合控制；而通过化学修饰增强氢键作用，可提升 lignin 在溶液中的行为与分散性。此外，基于 lignin 的共聚物如乳酸酯接枝物，展示了其在提高材料柔韧性和强度方面的潜力。这些策略超越了传统流水线工作模式，强调了对 lignin 聚合机制的深入理解及其在高附加值应用中的价值。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了 lignin 在高性能材料中的应用前景，指出其通过物理、化学和生物方法聚合可提升分子量与可控性。尽管 lignin 存在低分子量和分散度问题，但通过聚合可改善其机械性能。研究显示，利用酶催化、共价交联等策略能有效提高 lignin 的分子量，并拓展其在环保、生物医药等领域的应用。然而，目前工业过程仍主要将其作为低聚物处理，限制了高价值材料的开发。
items.future_directions: 未来可进一步研究如何通过物理聚合和化学交联策略提升 lignin 的分子量与可控性，以开发高性能的 lignin 基材料。此外，探索 lignin 与其他生物质成分的混合物在生物医学和环境防护中的应用潜力也是关键方向。基于本文中提到的酶促聚合机制及功能化方法，可设计后续实验验证 DIR 蛋白对 lignin 结构调控的影响，并评估其在不同环境条件下的稳定性与活性。

fields.en: Lignin is a polyphenolic component present in the cells of woody plants, providing structural support, facilitating long-distance water transport, and acting as a barrier against pathogens and microorganisms. Lignin is formed by the oxidation of phenolic monomers through radical coupling and dimerization. The resulting lignin macromolecules contain modifiable functional groups, including methoxy, hydroxyl, phenolic hydroxyl, and carbonyl groups. The complex three-dimensional structure endows lignin with various natural properties, including adhesion, hydrophobicity, antioxidant activity, and UV protection. In addition to its natural functions in plants, artificially extracted lignin can enhance plant nutrient absorption through ion exchange and chelation, while improving soil porosity. This paper reviews the strategies and applications of lignin-derived polymeric materials (such as resins, nanoparticles, fibers, and gels), and discusses the prospects for developing high-performance lignin polymeric materials. Lignin polymerization strategies include physical (aggregation), chemical (chain extension, crosslinking, and grafting), and biological (enzyme-promoted) methods. We critically analyze these polymerization routes, including physical aggregation, covalent crosslinking, chemical chain extension, polymer grafting, and enzyme-promoted polymerization reactions. We begin by outlining the current status of lignin polymerization in plant tissues. As a complex polyphenolic macromolecule, lignin is typically intertwined with cellulose and hemicellulose to enhance the mechanical strength, stiffness, and hydrophobicity of secondary cell walls in plants. Lignification occurs during the later stages of plant development, forming rigid wood tissue that is difficult to digest even for ruminants. Oxidases and peroxidases (whether free or bound) in the cell wall determine the spatial localization of lignification, determining its position by catalyzing the polymerization of lignin monomers (Figure 2). It becomes evident that the enzymatic process of coupling phenolic compounds to form lignin is highly complex and goes beyond the traditional models of laccases and peroxidases. A recent study identified a class of proteins containing dirigent domains (DIRs), which regulate the primary structure of lignin in plant roots by controlling the region/stereochemistry of radical coupling (Figure 2). By analyzing the expression patterns of 25 DIRs in Arabidopsis, Gao found that five genes (DIR9, DIR24, DIR16, DIR18, and ESB1) showed specific expression in the endodermis of roots. The localization of all selected DIRs in the endodermis, particularly in the Casparian strip, was confirmed through fusion with the fluorescent protein mCherry. The integrity of the Casparian strip was assessed by detecting lignin deposition in individual DIR mutants. Furthermore, researchers also explored the effects of environmental factors on DIR activity in plants. This work reveals a mechanism for Casparian strip lignification that requires cooperation between DIR and Schengen pathways. The investigation was further extended to the sources of enzymes, with both bacteria and fungi showing potential for polymerizing lignin-related small molecules. Physically aggregated lignin is promoted by various intermolecular and intramolecular interactions, which may be either repulsive or cohesive, including electrostatic interactions, hydrogen bonds, π-π stacking interactions, and van der Waals forces (Figure 4). The amphiphilic nature of lignin also promotes the formation of aggregates with reduced surface energy in a given solvent. Lignin naturally possesses a large number of hydrogen bond donor and acceptor groups, including hydroxyl, carboxyl, and ether groups. This chemical structure leads to the widespread presence of hydrogen bonds within and between lignin molecules (e.g., β-O-4′) as well as hydrogen bonds between lignin and other substances, including solvents, significantly affecting the solution behavior of lignin. Hydrogen bonds are considered key driving forces for the aggregation behavior of lignin in solution and can be controlled through chemical modification of its functional groups. Furthermore, at certain solid interfaces, such as on inorganic oxides, hydrogen bonds play a crucial role in the adsorption and dispersion behavior of lignin-based dispersants.

paragraphs.en: Lignin is a polyphenolic component present in the cells of woody plants, providing structural support, facilitating long-distance water transport, and acting as a barrier against pathogens and microorganisms. Lignin is formed by the oxidation of phenolic monomers through radical coupling and dimerization. The resulting lignin macromolecules contain modifiable functional groups, including methoxy, hydroxyl, phenolic hydroxyl, and carbonyl groups. The complex three-dimensional structure endows lignin with various natural properties, including adhesion, hydrophobicity, antioxidant activity, and UV protection. In addition to its natural functions in plants, artificially extracted lignin can enhance plant nutrient absorption through ion exchange and chelation, while improving soil porosity. This paper reviews the strategies and applications of lignin-derived polymeric materials (such as resins, nanoparticles, fibers, and gels), and discusses the prospects for developing high-performance lignin polymeric materials. Lignin polymerization strategies include physical (aggregation), chemical (chain extension, crosslinking, and grafting), and biological (enzyme-promoted) methods. We critically analyze these polymerization routes, including physical aggregation, covalent crosslinking, chemical chain extension, polymer grafting, and enzyme-promoted polymerization reactions. We begin by outlining the current status of lignin polymerization in plant tissues. As a complex polyphenolic macromolecule, lignin is typically intertwined with cellulose and hemicellulose to enhance the mechanical strength, stiffness, and hydrophobicity of secondary cell walls in plants. Lignification occurs during the later stages of plant development, forming rigid wood tissue that is difficult to digest even for ruminants. Oxidases and peroxidases (whether free or bound) in the cell wall determine the spatial localization of lignification, determining its position by catalyzing the polymerization of lignin monomers (Figure 2). It becomes evident that the enzymatic process of coupling phenolic compounds to form lignin is highly complex and goes beyond the traditional models of laccases and peroxidases. A recent study identified a class of proteins containing dirigent domains (DIRs), which regulate the primary structure of lignin in plant roots by controlling the region/stereochemistry of radical coupling (Figure 2). By analyzing the expression patterns of 25 DIRs in Arabidopsis, Gao found that five genes (DIR9, DIR24, DIR16, DIR18, and ESB1) showed specific expression in the endodermis of roots. The localization of all selected DIRs in the endodermis, particularly in the Casparian strip, was confirmed through fusion with the fluorescent protein mCherry. The integrity of the Casparian strip was assessed by detecting lignin deposition in individual DIR mutants. Furthermore, researchers also explored the effects of environmental factors on DIR activity in plants. This work reveals a mechanism for Casparian strip lignification that requires cooperation between DIR and Schengen pathways. The investigation was further extended to the sources of enzymes, with both bacteria and fungi showing potential for polymerizing lignin-related small molecules. Physically aggregated lignin is promoted by various intermolecular and intramolecular interactions, which may be either repulsive or cohesive, including electrostatic interactions, hydrogen bonds, π-π stacking interactions, and van der Waals forces (Figure 4). The amphiphilic nature of lignin also promotes the formation of aggregates with reduced surface energy in a given solvent. Lignin naturally possesses a large number of hydrogen bond donor and acceptor groups, including hydroxyl, carboxyl, and ether groups. This chemical structure leads to the widespread presence of hydrogen bonds within and between lignin molecules (e.g., β-O-4′) as well as hydrogen bonds between lignin and other substances, including solvents, significantly affecting the solution behavior of lignin. Hydrogen bonds are considered key driving forces for the aggregation behavior of lignin in solution and can be controlled through chemical modification of its functional groups. Furthermore, at certain solid interfaces, such as on inorganic oxides, hydrogen bonds play a crucial role in the adsorption and dispersion behavior of lignin-based dispersants.

fields.en:
The author proposes the potential of lignin as a high-performance material by analyzing its structure and function. In the introduction, the author points out that the low molecular weight and high dispersibility of lignin are the main limiting factors, and emphasizes that polymerization can increase its molecular weight and controllability. Subsequently, the author systematically classified the aggregation strategies of lignin, including physical, chemical, and biological methods, and analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of these methods. By comparing the mechanisms and applications of different aggregation pathways, the authors verified the importance of aggregation in enhancing material properties. In addition, the authors explored the role of enzymes in biopolymerization and the impact of the DIR protein, further ruling out alternative explanations. The review section organizes evidence and compares the feasibility of physical, chemical, and biological polymerization pathways, emphasizing the critical role of hydrogen bonds in polymerization behavior. These steps ensure the scientific and logical validity of the conclusions, providing theoretical support for the development of high-performance lignin materials.

fields.zh:
作者通过分析 lignin 的结构和功能，提出其作为高性能材料的潜力。在介绍中，作者指出 lignin 的低分子量和高分散性是主要限制因素，并强调聚合可提高其分子量和可控性。随后，作者系统分类了 lignin 的聚合策略，包括物理、化学和生物方法，并分析了这些方法的优缺点。通过比较不同聚合途径的机制和应用，作者验证了聚合对提升材料性能的重要性。此外，作者探讨了生物聚合中酶的作用及 DIR 蛋白的影响，进一步排除了替代解释。综述部分通过组织证据，对比了物理、化学和生物聚合路径的可行性，并强调了氢键在聚合行为中的关键作用。这些步骤确保了结论的科学性和逻辑性，为高性能 lignin 材料的发展提供了理论支持。
